_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' KSP DMP egg (MIT).
name: KSP Dark Multiplayer
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Dark Multiplayer, the multiplayer mod for Kerbal Space Program. Installs the DMP server release you choose; players need the matching DMP client mod.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# KSP Dark Multiplayer. Downloads the DMP server release from d-mp.org.
# The universe (Universe/), settings and ban lists (Config/) and plugins are
# never touched; the server's files are only replaced once the download is
# complete.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

page=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://d-mp.org/downloads) || fail "d-mp.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# The releases, newest first, as d-mp.org lists them.
versions=$(grep -oE '/builds/release/v[0-9][0-9.]*/DMPServer\.zip' <<<"$page" | sed 's#/builds/release/v##; s#/DMPServer\.zip##' | awk '!seen[$0]++')
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    version=$(head -n 1 <<<"$versions")
    [ -n "$version" ] || fail "d-mp.org lists no server release right now. Reinstall to try again later."
else
    version="${want#v}"
    grep -qxF "$version" <<<"$versions" || fail "Dark Multiplayer has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(head -n 1 <<<"$versions")."
fi

if [ -f DMPServer.exe ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-dmp 2>/dev/null)" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "Dark Multiplayer $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Dark Multiplayer $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/DMPServer.zip" "https://d-mp.org/builds/release/v$version/DMPServer.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    unzip -q "$build/DMPServer.zip" -d "$build/x"
    src=$(dirname "$(find "$build/x" -name DMPServer.exe | head -n 1)")
    [ -f "$src/DMPServer.exe" ] || fail "The download didn't contain the server. Reinstall to try again."
    cp -a "$src/." /mnt/server/
    echo "$version" > .raptor-dmp
fi

# The server fills in the rest of its settings on first start.
if [ ! -f Config/Settings.txt ]; then
    mkdir -p Config
    printf 'port=6702\nserverName=A Dark Multiplayer server\n' > Config/Settings.txt
fi
echo "Installed Dark Multiplayer $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The DMP server release to install, such as 0.3.8.5, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can join at once.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: EASY, NORMAL, MODERATE, HARD or CUSTOM.

variables.name: Warp mode
variables.description: How players share time warp: SUBSPACE (each their own), SUBSPACE_SIMPLE, MCW_FORCE, MCW_VOTE, MCW_LOWEST, or NONE.

variables.name: Mod pack mode
variables.description: Whether players can sync mods from the server: NONE, CKAN (Config/DarkMultiPlayer.ckan) or GAMEDATA (Config/GameData).

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: True lets only whitelisted players join.
